constraints.action: maintain controlled normothermia (36.5° C–37.7° C) until 72 hours after randomization
institute pharmacological and other conservative measures to maintain normothermia if core temperature approached 37.5° C
place a temperature management device to target a core temperature of 37.5° C if conservative measures are unsuccessful
follow neuroprognostication protocols for all subjects who remained unresponsive at 96 hours after randomization
prevent fever targeting <37.5° C for most patients
constraints.source_section: WHAT THE TTM2 RESULTS SHOULD NOT CHANGE

constraints.action: target core temperature <37.7° C for at least 72 hours after cardiac arrest
treat unresponsive adult patients with cardiac arrest with temperature management targeting a temperature between 32° C and 36° C for 24 hours of therapy
control patient temperature to <37.5° C for unresponsive post–cardiac arrest adult patients with characteristics similar to those of individuals included in the TTM2 trial
strictly prevent fever with continuous temperature monitoring for unresponsive post–cardiac arrest adult patients
provide comprehensive critical care support for unresponsive post–cardiac arrest adult patients
deploy multimodal evidence-based strategies for neuroprognostication at a minimum of 72 hours after normothermia for unresponsive post–cardiac arrest adult patients
avoid early prognostication and withdrawal of life-sustaining therapy
